## Design decisions

- Records-in only — every leg evaluator folds supplied facts (probe
  results, mediation/observer outcomes, policy declarations, the
  landed quote); the module never manufactures an execution, a
  capability or a pass. `unsupported`/`inconclusive`/`refused` are
  typed returns for scope decision.
- hh-env is the owner home (R5.32/33/34 machinery); the worksheet leg
  consumes `hharness_eval::exposure_quote::build_quote` unchanged —
  no new dep/RecordKind/event class/wire name/kernel arm; public
  vocabulary stays inside the admitted leg names.
- The live drive runs the actual lane the host supports: podman is
  probed honestly (`inconclusive` when absent); the mediation and
  observer legs run real on the seatbelt lane with
  `carrier_backend` recorded verbatim — the HelperExecutor machinery,
  not a substitute.
